scenario_order: exact order of scenario_ids in the I05 protocol lock
numerator: sum of the two checkpoint integer loss-count differences
variance: unbiased within-scenario variance; stream is the sampling unit; integer sufficient statistics before division
rng_tape: C-order uint8 indices; SHA-256 pinned for each locked primary seed; regenerate and compare on every host
python_requirement: CPython >=3.11; observed and bound per host
quantile_rule: ceil((B+1)*0.975)=9750; one-based order statistic; no interpolation
holm: fixed ordered family J1,J2; stable tie ordering; step-down adjusted p-values and alpha=0.05
equivalence_boundaries: inclusive at both ends; BENEFICIAL/HARMFUL strictly beyond delta
observed_zero_se: p=1; confidence interval [-1,1]; INCONCLUSIVE; no assertion of equivalence
bootstrap_zero_se: retain resample as positive infinite absolute pivot; no dropping, redraw or change to B
nonfinite_json: represent positive infinity as the string +Infinity; NaN rejected
secondary_scope: exact J_SUM closure, family/checkpoint contrasts and embedded horizon point summaries only; no unregistered secondary significance labels
resource_scope: paired stream-cluster point summaries with explicit metric scopes and missingness; no fabricated arm-isolated RSS or latency quantiles
precedent: F11 bootstrap-t moment estimator, conservative degeneracy handling and integer-rank quantile convention; primary family changes only as already locked at I05
shared_dependency_limit: Independent Node arithmetic consumes independently hash-checked draw tapes generated by NumPy; not an independent investigator or independent PRNG implementation.
